meta.title: 48 Hours exploring Hoi An OLD TOWN 🇻🇳 (must try food + tips)
meta.description:
Visiting Hoi An? Watch this first! I spent a few days exploring the charming, historic Old Town, uncovering some of the very best things to see, eat and do. I've also got some great tips for visiting a tailor and leather worker to get things custom-made. 

✈️ To get to Hoi An I flew to Da Nang International Airport and arranged a transfer to my hotel. Find flights: ttps://skyscanner.pxf.io/R50ba7
🚙 Pre-book your airport transfer: https://kiwitaxi.tp.st/8kK0umsb

Want to book? Here are all the links you need: 
📍 Hoi An Emotion Boutique Villa & Hotel: https://agoda.tp.st/azNDs6H7
🎟 Find and book the best things to do here: https://tinyurl.com/f67vnk75

Cloth Shop Thanh Thuy (Flower's tailor shop) 
53 Hoang Dieu Street, Hoi An Town / bananasplitcafe@hotmail.com / Whatsapp +84935875116 - I had 1 x linen wrap skirt, 1 x linen wrap dress, 2 x linen wrap tops, 1 x linen trousers and 1 x lined white dress made for around USD $200. I felt this was excellent value for tailor-made clothes that fit my body perfectly, made from high-quality fabric! 

Song Leather 
49 Tran Phu Street, Hoi An / songstyle.vn@gmail.com / Whatsapp +84772494051 

Post Service (The sweet lady's name is Dao) 
Whatsapp +84938284115
